sys_atf_test.name: Compliance: _checkWriteScope returns confirmed-readonly for read-only grants
sys_atf_test.description: Given a fixture app registration holding only *.Read.* application permissions and a User.Read delegated scope, _checkWriteScope must return 'confirmed-readonly'.

sys_atf_step.description: Fixture a read-only-scoped registration; assert _checkWriteScope affirmatively confirms it.
